judgement.reason: Paperless-ngx keeps its core data, the scanned document originals, archives and the search index, in local media and data directories, and Deployz has no persistent volumes; the shown lines do not prove whether S3 can replace them.

evidence.quote: Paperless-ngx is a document management system that transforms your physical documents into a searchable online archive so you can keep, well, _less paper_.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 20 long-running services (init-compile-bytecode, init-complete, init-custom-init, init-env-file) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The image starts s6-overlay via /init, which supervises several long-running services in one container, and no shown line proves otherwise.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /usr/src/paperless/data (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The data volume holds durable application state such as the search index and documents, and no shown setting moves it to a managed service.
